items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: she introduced our class to poetry: James Weldon Johnson, Richard Wright, Claude McKay.

ctx.x: What do you recollect about her that made her such a good teacher.

For one thing, she failed – I got an F in her class, which – I don’t like to say she failed me, because it really wasn’t her fault. But I think – she introduced our class to poetry: James Weldon Johnson, Richard Wright, Claude McKay.
